items.headline: FDA approves third-ever treatment for fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva
items.summary: The FDA approved zilurgisertib, sold as Atebrioz, a daily pill that targets the faulty gene pathway causing a rare disease that turns muscle and connective tissue into bone. In its trial, patients on the drug saw new bone growth shrink on average, while those on placebo saw it continue to grow.
items.why_it_matters: It gives patients with an ultra-rare, severely disabling disease a third approved option that addresses the underlying biology rather than just symptoms.
